learningObjectives: Apply grouping and aggregation operations to datasets.
Combine multiple datasets using merge and join operations.
Transform tabular data for analytical workflows.

activities.title: Explore GroupBy
activities.instruction: Group the dataset and inspect the results.

content.concept: GroupBy divides data into groups so that aggregate operations can be applied to each group.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Match Aggregations
activities.instruction: Match each aggregation with its purpose.

content.concept: Sum, mean, count, minimum, and maximum summarize grouped data in different ways.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Join the Datasets
activities.instruction: Connect the tables using the correct key.

content.concept: Merge and join operations combine related datasets using common columns or indexes.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Transform the Data
activities.instruction: Arrange the transformation steps in order.

content.concept: Data transformation reshapes, derives, filters, and aggregates information for analysis.
